name: Balotra

queries.query: Balotra Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map land records Bhu Naksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha viewer, the Government of India DILRMP Balotra cadastral-status page, the Rajasthan Urban GIS Khasra-search portal, and the official Urban Improvement Trust Balotra site. The Bhu-Naksha host timed out during bounded anonymous retrieval; no parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: बालोतरा राजस्थान आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख खसरा नक्शा
queries.result: प्रथम-पक्ष खोज में राजस्थान सरकार का भू-नक्शा दर्शक, भारत सरकार का बालोतरा DILRMP कैडस्ट्रल-स्थिति पृष्ठ, राजस्थान का राजधारा अर्बन GIS खसरा-सर्च पोर्टल और नगर सुधार न्यास बालोतरा की आधिकारिक साइट मिली। सीमित अनामिक अनुरोध में भू-नक्शा होस्ट टाइमआउट हुआ; कोई पार्सल फीचर प्रतिक्रिया नहीं मिली।

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Rajasthan revenue/settlement authorities and the Balotra district administration context evidenced by the official DILRMP Balotra page; the official Urban Improvement Trust Balotra site is a local urban-planning custodian but did not expose a parcel feature response.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalStatusService: Government of India Department of Land Resources DILRMP Balotra cadastral-map/ULPIN status page at https://dilrmp.gov.in/dilrmpold/MapULPIN/tehsil-level/820.
officialSourceAssessment.urbanMapService: Rajasthan Government Rajdharaa Urban GIS portal at https://rajdharaa.rajasthan.gov.in/citizenudh/index, whose public page exposes Khasra Search and states that settlement-department khasra/village boundaries are for viewing.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: First-party Rajasthan cadastral viewer and first-party DILRMP Balotra district cadastral context are evidenced, with a Balotra-specific official urban custodian site. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide geometry coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: Official first-party sources explicitly identify Rajasthan cadastral mapping and Balotra district/urban-government context; anonymous parcel inspection remained unavailable.
